tabs animation

Motion·by @marcelkargul·2026-08-19·inspora page·original post

What it is

Tabs animation: a minimal dark tab bar ('Emails' / 'Attachments' with icons) where the active tab becomes a little stage light - it lights up from below: a soft radial glow pools under the tab and a subtle cone of light rises beneath the text, plus a crisp white underline; switching tabs sweeps the light across.

Media

Frame-by-frame

0-25%
'Emails' active: white text + 2px underline, glow blooming beneath the tab against the black wall; 'Attachments' dim grey.
25-50%
Mid-switch: underline + glow travel from Emails to Attachments; glow smears during transit (motion blur feel).
50-100%
'Attachments' active with its own light pool; states alternate; inactive tab sits in darkness (white/35).

Mechanics

trigger
tab click
elements
tab labels + icons, underline indicator, glow pool / light cone
properties
underline translateX+width, glow x, intensity, smear
timing
switch 450ms
easing
spring-ish ease-out (slight overshoot on underline)
loop
demo alternates

Build prompt

Build lit-stage tabs. Near-black background (#0A0A0A). Two tabs centered ('Emails' inbox icon, 'Attachments' paperclip icon, 14px). Inactive: white/35, no underline. Active: white text, 2px white underline (inset 10px each side), and light: a 140px radial gradient pool (white/12, blur 20) under the tab plus a faint vertical light cone (linear-gradient white/6 -> transparent, 40px tall) rising above the underline, like an uplight. On switch: underline slides to the new tab with 8% overshoot (450ms cubic-bezier(0.2,0.8,0.2,1)); the glow detaches, stretches horizontally (scaleX 1.6, opacity dipping to 6%) during transit, then re-pools under the new tab (spring settle 300ms). Icons swap fill weight with the text color.
